GroupMe

Your GroupMe groups inside Dock. Read messages, load earlier messages, and send text from your phone or computer.

Run GroupMe →

Connect your account

Register an application at GroupMe Developers, using the callback URL shown on the connection page. Have your public Client ID ready.

Connect GroupMe →

Authorize your account, then copy the resulting token directly into the Cloudflare Worker secret GROUPME_ACCESS_TOKEN and deploy the settings. The connection page guides you through these steps.

Keep the token private. Do not paste it into chat, project files, or the browser console. It stays on the Worker; GroupMe messages are fetched when you open the app and are not saved in Dock storage.

This version supports group text conversations, not SMS or direct messages. Your GroupMe account and groups must already exist. Bark must allow access to GroupMe.
